Also removes redundant horizontal rules (---) from body text (frontmatter boundaries kept), keeps inline tags and frontmatter tags in sync, and respects dinox/五彩-managed frontmatter fields (sync fields like feishu_url, noteId, 创建时间, oldtitle stay untouched to avoid sync-overwrite loops).
